decisions.decision: Mr. Alonzo suggested Town Counsel attend the Board three or four times annually; Ms. Bertram agreed (no vote recorded).

budget_items.topic: Accounts payable and payroll warrants signed
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an accounts payable warrant and three payroll warrants.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $1,746,634.34; a payroll warrant in the amount of $778,243.30, another payroll warrant in the amount of $560.04, and a payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $492,481.68.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Acting Town Manager Burney read the remaining 2017 renewals, with the common victualer fee printed as $25.00.
budget_items.quote: mr. burney stated these are some remaining renewals for 2017. he read the list aloud: common victualer $25.00

budget_items.topic: Class I auto dealer license renewal fee
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Class I auto dealer license renewal fee was read aloud.
budget_items.quote: mr. burney read the auto dealer license renewal: class l auto dealer $100.00

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Luck announced the pancake breakfast price of $2.00 per person, with take-out available.
budget_items.quote: ms. luck reminded everyone about the pancake breakfast tomorrow morning from 8:00 to 11:00 a.m. at eagle house senior center. $2.00 per person, take out is available.

budget_items.topic: Salvation Army toll booth fundraiser proceeds
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Public comment described the Salvation Army toll booth fundraiser's record collections and stated that 83% of the money collected stays in the local community.
budget_items.quote: 83% of the money collected stays in the local community to go to hundreds of families.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Luck reported that school principals presented 2018 budget requests, with an increase in requests to hire new personnel.
budget_items.quote: ms. luck reported the school committee met last week and school principals presented their 2018 budget requests.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Conservation Commission received a grant for a forest stewardship plan; RFPs went to three foresters and one bid was returned.
budget_items.quote: the commission received a $20,000 grant for a forest stewardship plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Bertram stated legal services is a significant portion of the budget, and the Board discussed going out for legal services proposals.
budget_items.quote: ms. bertram stated legal services is a significant portion of the budget.
